decisions.title: Decision Studio
decisions.description: Ask bounded questions about text, JSON or an image. Requests may incur provider charges.
decisions.noModels: No accessible text models support Decisions.
decisions.imageHelp: PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF. Maximum 4 MiB per image; 8 MiB total request. JSON: 256 KiB, 32 levels, 10,000 values. Image URLs go to the provider, not this server.
decisions.question: Question {number}
decisions.name: Name
decisions.label: Label
decisions.cancelled: Cancelled. Upstream work may still incur charges.
decisions.cancelHelp: Cancel stops waiting; it does not guarantee upstream cancellation. Requests never retry automatically.
decisions.invalidRequest: Complete the input and every question instruction.
decisions.invalidJson: Enter a JSON object or an array of objects.
decisions.jsonLimit: JSON exceeds 256 KiB, 32 levels or 10,000 values.
decisions.invalidImage: Use an HTTP(S) image URL or a PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF base64 data URL.
decisions.imageLimit: Image must be PNG, JPEG, WebP or GIF and no larger than 4 MiB.
decisions.requestLimit: Total request must not exceed 8 MiB.
decisions.choiceLimit: Provide 2–255 choices with nonempty values and descriptions.
decisions.levelLimit: Provide 2–10 levels with nonempty labels and descriptions.
decisions.emptyResults: Run decisions to inspect answers, usage and cost.
decisions.unavailable: Decisions is unavailable for this model.
